craft_notes: Sthāyin: double burning. Sanskrit-first: hand-and-heart kept paired. Rows: 3. Close: char. Rejected: dropping hṛdaya — killed: inner fire is the transfer. Read aloud: doubling cadence.

lines: One seed, two fires — without, within — charred by the spell-bound mind.
